rows.en: That's right!! And Regis, by erasing the justice that the likes of you stand for,
and bringing every world to an end in despair, will be complete as the perfect world...!!
had been compressed and stored inside those stone pillars.
Hah! Die nice and quiet, and I'll bring you back later!!
As my servants, that is!! Guhahahahahahahahahaha!!!
...Do not misunderstand. The one who will cut you down is me.
Zamsha... You're not even a hero, you bastard...
What of it? All I pursue is pure strength...
Belial!! I challenge you to a duel!!
Belial is my prey. I need no help. You lot, deal with that Greeed.
Zamsha!! You've got some nerve pulling this crap!!
Pay me no mind!! ...Hurry, defeat the Greeed!!
Quite the rude interruption, but even that looks set to give me a beautiful memory of the end.
Now then, won't you lend me your cooperation as well?
You'll suffer, suffer, suffer to the bitter end as you fall... I'll store that finest memory in this Memory!!
That's the "Memory Memory"!! Dinosaur Greeed, what on earth are you...!!
That's the "Memory Memory"!! You fiend, what on earth are you...!!
That Memory...!! Just what the hell are you scheming, you bastard...!!

notes.note: Script plays this between #0.291 and #0.292 (MessWinSet +290,+300,+291). Belial finishes #0.291's sentence ('All the Minus Energy gathered from every Cube,' ... 'had been compressed and stored inside those stone pillars.'); #0.291 must end so this continuation reads.

Party-leader variants #0.302-316 follow character id order 1-15 (Rider 1, Black RX, Den-O Sword, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero), confirmed by the rough Momotaros wording at index 2 in 0731 variant blocks. Extractor's '00' label on the first row is the script's fixed name call, not a real speaker; all identical Japanese -> identical English.
Dinosaur Greeed replies to Belial's #0.298. 'Justice like yours' rendered as 'the justice that the likes of you stand for'; sentence split across #0.299/#0.300 at the source's comma.
Zamsha to the heroes after blocking Belial's blow: he saved them only because he means to cut them down himself.
Belial's kudaranee rendered at full rudeness ('What a load of crap!!'); Zamsha's mondou muyou -> 'Enough talk!!'.
Dinosaur Greeed: Zamsha's intrusion is unwelcome, yet the duel itself will yield a 'beautiful memory of the end' for the Memory Memory. 'the end' = his recurring 'finish/ending' theme.
Memory Memory: Gaia Memory from Movie War Core (Kamen Rider Wiki spelling). Not in glossary. Kept in double quotes as the source sets it off in brackets.

Variants with kisama (Black RX, W, OOO, Wing Zero, 00, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero) -> 'You fiend, what on earth are you...!!'; omae variants (Zeta, God Gundam) drop the address. Trailing 'what on earth are you...' kept unfinished as in source. #0.372 (Momotaros) does not name the Memory and says 'scheming'.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0731.bla; all extractor labels match the script. #0.301 is the continuation of #0.291 (script order). New term: "Memory Memory" (not in glossary).
